sidebar.empty: No sessions yet. Hit {action} to start.
sidebar.lockedLoad: Stop the current session before loading another
sidebar.deleteSessionBody: "{title}" and its recording will be permanently deleted.
sidebar.deleteGroupBody: "{name}" will be removed. Its sessions are kept and moved out of the group.

diarize.blocking: Speaker identification is running — wait for it to finish
diarize.confirmRenames: This will reset any speaker renames (e.g. Alice → Speaker 1).
diarize.confirmExisting: This session already has speaker labels.

translate.blocking: Translation is running — wait for it to finish
translate.confirmAll: Every segment already has a translation — this will replace them all.

preflight.refreshHint: Refresh the window list (grant Screen Recording first)
preflight.privacy: Running locally · no audio leaves your device

transcript.preparingHint: First start takes a moment while Whisper and the translator load.
transcript.listeningHint: Start speaking. Words will appear here as they're recognised.
transcript.editHint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel
transcript.speakerUnknown: Unidentified — click to name this speaker (this segment only)
transcript.speakerRename: Click to rename — applies to all segments by this speaker

player.scrollTo: Scroll to this segment in the transcript
player.abOn: A–B loop on — click to clear
player.abSetA: A–B loop — click to set point A

chat.clearBody: All messages in this conversation will be removed.
chat.deleteBody: "{title}" and all its messages will be removed.
chat.noSessionHint: Chat is anchored to the active recording. Hit Record to begin.
chat.readyHint: Start talking — your questions can reference whatever gets captured.
chat.askHint: Summaries, action items, decisions, who-said-what — try it.

upload.title: Transcribe from file
upload.drop: Drop files or click to choose
upload.dropHint: Audio or video · any format ffmpeg supports · multiple files will be concatenated in the listed order
upload.background: Processing continues in the background — you can close this.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: The interface language. Auto follows your system.
settings.appearanceHint: Light, dark, or follow your system.
settings.speakerLiveHint: Experimental — unreliable mid-call. The post-process Identify speakers button is much better.
settings.continuousPlaybackHint: When you hit play on a segment, keep playing past its boundary. Off = pause when the segment ends.
settings.levelMetersHint: Tiny mic + speaker volume bars in the bottom status bar. Turn off if you find them distracting.
settings.minSilenceHint: How long the speaker must pause before closing a segment. ~800ms suits conversation.
settings.maxSegmentHint: Hard cap. Whisper's context limit is 30s; leave a buffer.
settings.partialIntervalHint: How often partial transcripts are emitted. Lower = snappier but more GPU.
settings.translatePartialsHint: Stream translations of partial transcripts (a beat after the text).
settings.nextSessionNote: Some changes only take effect on the next session.
settings.enginesEmpty: Start a session to see the active backends.

setup.computeBlurb: Everything runs on your device. Pick the build that matches your hardware — you can change this later in Settings.
setup.modelsBlurb: Runs fully on your device. One-time download of the speech & translation models.
setup.skip: Skip — use the built-in CPU build
setup.restart: Restart Wrenote afterwards to use the new runtime.

compute.autoHint: Auto ranks by detected hardware and falls back to the built-in runtime. A pinned accelerator must be installed below.
compute.indexUnreachable: Pack index unreachable — installs are unavailable offline.
compute.restart: Restart Wrenote to apply the new compute runtime.

reason.driver_too_old: {gpu} · driver {driver} is older than the {min} CUDA 12 needs — update it to use CUDA
reason.intel_mac: Intel Mac — no Metal build is shipped

note.builtin: Built into the app · nothing to download
note.unpublished: Not published for this machine yet
note.size_unknown: Download size unknown until the pack index is checked
